headline: Petlibro’s new AI-powered feeder is a game changer for multi-cat homes
context: Petlibro's new Granary 2 smart feeders use a built-in scale and (on pricier models) an AI camera to track exactly how much your cat is eating and when — though the fanciest health-monitoring features will cost you an extra subscription.
